sources.entry: OpenPanel | Web and product analytics, a Mixpanel alternative

summary.one_liner: OpenPanel is an open-source, self-hostable web and product analytics platform positioned as an alternative to Mixpanel.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes funnels, cohorts, user profiles and session history, plus session replay with built-in privacy controls. It offers real-time dashboards, custom charts, A/B testing with variant breakdowns, and event- and funnel-based notifications. Tracking is cookieless and the README claims GDPR compliance. It provides SDKs for web, Swift, Kotlin and React Native, a developer API, and an MCP server for querying data from AI clients. Revenue tracking and a Google Search Console integration are also listed.
how_to_run: bun run migrate:deploy # once to setup the db
notable: Self-hostable with Docker Compose, with the README stating full control over data
Session replay with no session limit, contrasted against Mixpanel's caps
Hosted MCP server exposing 38 tools for Claude, Cursor or other MCP clients
Comparison table against Mixpanel, GA4 and Plausible in the README
caveats: Self-hosting setup details are behind a link in the README rather than spelled out; the development setup requires Docker, Docker Compose and Bun
The comparison table and pricing claims are the project's own marketing and are not independently verified
The README does not state a license
